We confirm our intent to comply with the Energy Department, Government of Punjab’s requirements for the design, supply, installation and commissioning of grid-tied Solar PV systems totaling 5 MW across twelve public hospitals, including site surveys, detailed engineering, testing/commissioning, and delivery within the RFP’s technical and administrative framework.

Relevant experience: our project portfolio evidences completed Solar Energy deployments (including federal/provincial government engagements) [CAP-020][CAP-008][CAP-032][CAP-044] and prior delivery for federal and provincial government clients in Pakistan [CAP-042][CAP-018][CAP-004][CAP-003][CAP-002][CAP-049]. Our quality management approach is evidenced through delivery under ISO 9001 on prior engagements [CAP-030][CAP-022][CAP-039]. We also evidence PMP-aligned project delivery capability through projects delivered under PMP credentialed leadership [CAP-005][CAP-027].

Mandatory gaps and closure plan (as our library does not yet evidence them): Tier-1 PV modules/string inverters/mounting structures, including minimum 21% module efficiency and 25-year linear warranty; SCADA-based centralized monitoring; DISCO net-metering approvals; and 3-year comprehensive O&M with performance guarantees are not evidenced in the provided records; we will address these through nominated OEMs/O&M partners, and submit complete make/model datasheets, warranties, SCADA architecture, O&M SLAs, and a net-metering approvals responsibility matrix in our Technical Proposal.

Commercial/administrative compliance: our library does not yet evidence bid security issuance or FBR active taxpayer status; we will submit the 2% bank guarantee from a scheduled bank and an active taxpayer certificate with the bid. We will also meet 120-day bid validity, two-envelope submission, required originals/copies, correct addressee, and full responses to sections Q1–Q7 as stipulated.
